Class Fluids

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.resource.Fluids
public final class Fluids extends Object
Fluids: one global category, machineengine:fluid, for every addon and definition (D29). MachineEngine registers water and lava; addons create their own fluids in the same category with create(Key), so a pipe or port accepting any() moves every registered fluid. Fluid keys are <namespace>:fluid/<name>.

The unit, scale and bucket size are set in config.yml (resources.fluid) and read when the fluids are built.
